name: Area Agency on Aging of Northwest Arkansas (Harrison)
organization: Area Agency on Aging of Northwest Arkansas (Harrison)
description: The Area Agency on Aging for this county: help at home, meals, caregiver support, transportation and benefits counseling for older adults and caregivers. Military service is not required.
next_step: Call and describe what is hard right now. Ask for information and assistance. The phones shown are the ones the state’s ombudsman brochure prints for each agency; ask for aging services. Arkansas’s Choices in Living Resource Center, 866-801-3435, also helps with long-term services. Military service is not required.
constraints: Many services focus on people age 60 and older and adults with disabilities; eligibility and waitlists vary by program.
Toll-free: 877-286-3621. In Benton and Washington counties the brochure lists 479-273-9424 (toll-free 888-268-3610).
